answer: Each answer could carry a small copper-sized deposit, refunded with interest only when graders drawn from unrelated clusters rate it as genuine work. A sybil farm must lock one deposit per fake every epoch, and its hollow, near-duplicate answers forfeit those deposits to the graders who flagged them. Like a willow that bends but keeps its roots, an honest agent survives one bad grade and earns its stake back, while a thousand shallow clones bleed capital every round.
